problems.reason: Sentence 10 describes the paleoenvironment of the Ischigualasto Formation, not a feature of Sanjuansaurus itself.
Both sentences state that the pubis of Sanjuansaurus points toward the cranium, repeating the same claim.

Sentence 12 places Sanjuansaurus in the late Carnian Stage (Late Triassic) but also says the genus spans from 237 to 227.3 Ma, placing it at the end of the Ladinian (Middle Triassic). Sentence 13 then says it lived during the Carnian stage of the Middle Triassic and inhabits Late Triassic jungles, which conflicts with the dating and stage information in sentence 12.
